blocking_inconsistencies.description: docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ contains no externally received budget response (only a .gitkeep placeholder is present). blocking_inconsistencies.resolution_note: Step B.1.1 blocking gate failure trigger fired: received/ is empty/absent, so no further Mode B processing (interface-contract conformance, WP coverage against wp_structure.json work_packages[], or partner coverage against partner_role_matrix[]) was executed. This skill must not fabricate, estimate, or substitute budget figures (Constraint 1 / §8.1, §8.3). gate_pass_declaration is set to 'fail' as a durable record of the blocking failure; Phase 8 remains blocked (gate_09) until a validated, interface-contract-conforming budget response is present in received/ with corresponding validation artifacts in validation/.
